query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('variants',(SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE tenant=$1 AND parent_id=$2),'reviews',(SELECT count(*) FROM product_reviews WHERE tenant=$1 AND product_id=$2 AND approved),'averageRating',(SELECT coalesce(avg(rating),0) FROM product_reviews WHERE tenant=$1 AND product_id=$2 AND approved)) AS "stats!"
